title: Chapter 413: Collecting The Ice Phoenix As A Pet
content:
Chapter 413: Collecting The Ice Phoenix As A Pet

"I also have a treasure house with a lot of good things in it. I am willing to give them all to you."

When Wang Shuo heard this, he instantly felt excited.

Wang Shuo got a pet and a lot of treasures for nothing, so Wang Shuo had no reason to refuse.

The continent of Vlandia is so vast that even the Sword God may not be able to find him as long as he returns to the Great Sophora Territory.

"Then I will reluctantly agree to let you become my contracted beast!"

Although the formation that extracts the power of Nirvana is strong, it still cannot stop the contract summons.

The Ice Phoenix Emperor used his last effort to draw out the formation and gathered it at Wang Shuo's feet. Wang Shuo checked the formation and found that there was nothing wrong with it.

He had already mastered the know-how of the formation when he subdued the gold-eating demonic insect before, and the Ice Phoenix Emperor didn't do anything.

"agree."

Ice Phoenix Emperor and Wang Shuo established a relationship.

The Ice Phoenix Emperor immediately broke away from the formation that extracted the power of Nirvana, and then entered the breeding space of the three-headed hell dog.

Wang Shuo was shocked, he didn't expect the Ice Phoenix Emperor to have such ability.

After becoming his own contracted beast, he can actually share the hometown of another contracted beast.

Wang Shuo prayed silently, hoping that you can live in peace!

"If you go to someone else's house, you must not harm the three-headed hell dog."

Wang Shuo warned.

"Okay, don't worry, I have no interest in these low-level monsters."

"Let's leave this place quickly. It's too late. I'm afraid the Sword God will come back."

Wang Shuo glanced at the ice coffin, turned and left.

If Wang Shuo knew the name of the woman in the ice coffin, he would definitely take her away.

Even if he is being chased madly by the Sword God.

Come to the treasure house.

Wang Shuo discovered a large amount of high-grade ores and materials.

There are also a large number of finished weapons, which should be left behind after the Ice Phoenix Emperor killed humans.

Among them were several epic-level weapons, which made Wang Shuo extremely happy.

After packing them all up, Wang Shuo quickly left the underground.

Now we must find our teammates as soon as possible, and then leave here through the teleportation channel in Ice and Snow City.

Wang Shuo already knew that the teleportation gate in Ice and Snow City could only teleport people back to where they came from.

Others cannot pass through here to go to other regions.

Arriving on the ground, Wang Shuo quickly found Zhu Dongheng.

"Wang Shuo, are you okay? That's great!"

"Are you all okay? Where are the others?"

"Everyone else has been found, it's just you."

Wang Shuo felt relieved.

We must get out of here as soon as possible.

I don't know if the Sword God has noticed the changes here. If he catches him, it will be over.

"Without further ado, let's leave here immediately."

Zhu Dongheng was confused, had something big happened?

Wang Shuo didn't say much.

After everyone gathered together, they immediately set off towards Ice and Snow City.

Fortunately, Wang Shuo and others had just left through the teleportation array when the Sword God's figure flashed and appeared in the teleportation array.

He felt it on the spot in confusion, then rose into the sky and headed towards the Snowy Mountains.

Wang Shuo, who returned to Dahuai Territory, led everyone to Shanhai City.

In the side hall.

Wang Shuo told Zhao Bond and Zhu Dongheng what happened in the Snowy Mountains.

"So, you provoked an unimaginable being?"

Bond Zhao frowned, a little worried, but not afraid.

Wang Shuo summoned the Ice Phoenix Emperor.

"I've met two county guards."

The Ice Phoenix Emperor was still able to position himself correctly.

As a contracted beast, you still have to give face to your master.

Ice Phoenix Emperor also briefly talked about the strength of the Sword God.

Wang Shuo also shook his head helplessly. It seemed that the entire Dahuai Territory was probably no match for him.

Only by raising your strength to his level can you be able to fight against him!
